name: yaoc
description: Lightweight, non-blocking OpenClaw Gateway Chat & Workspace Client for Windows (x64 & ARM64)

scripts.build:tauri: npm run build:vite && cargo build --locked --release --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.build:tauri:x64: npm run build:vite && cargo build --locked --release --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --target x86_64-pc-windows-gnullvm
scripts.build:tauri:arm64: npm run build:vite && cargo build --locked --release --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --target aarch64-pc-windows-gnullvm
scripts.dist:all: npm run build:vite && cargo build --locked --release --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --target x86_64-pc-windows-gnullvm && cargo build --locked --release --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --target aarch64-pc-windows-gnullvm
scripts.release:x64: npm run build:vite:release && cargo build --locked --release --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --target x86_64-pc-windows-gnullvm
scripts.release:arm64: npm run build:vite:release && cargo build --locked --release --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --target aarch64-pc-windows-gnullvm
scripts.release: npm run build:vite:release && cargo build --locked --release --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --target x86_64-pc-windows-gnullvm && cargo build --locked --release --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --target aarch64-pc-windows-gnullvm

author: Lai Zit Seng
